🖥 Baqaei condemns territorial claims by UAE and Canada regarding three Iranian islands

📌 Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has strongly condemned the claims made by the United Arab Emirates and Canada regarding the three Iranian islands—as stated in a joint declaration by the Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and the Prime Minister of Canada—and, while emphasizing that Abu Musa, Greater Tunb, and Lesser Tunb belong to Iran in perpetuity, characterized this action as contrary to the principles of the UN Charter and international law.

Baqaei strongly condemned the insolent and interventionist claims made by the United Arab Emirates and Canada regarding the three Iranian islands—as set forth in a joint statement by the Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and the Prime Minister of Canada—and emphasized that the islands of Abu Musa, Greater Tunb, and Lesser Tunb are an inseparable and eternal part of Iran’s sovereign territory; furthermore, the repetition of baseless and fictitious claims concerning them will in no way alter established geographical, historical, and legal realities.
​
Condemning Canada’s absurd move to align itself with the UAE government in making territorial claims against Iran, the Foreign Ministry spokesperson noted that such an action by Canada—a country itself facing territorial claims from the US administration—is shortsighted, violates the fundamental principles of the UN Charter, runs counter to international law, and entails international responsibility for the Canadian government.
​
Baqaei advised the UAE government to adhere to the principle of good neighborliness, rather than fruitlessly repeating territorial claims against a large neighboring country.

🔊 Iran’s strength lies in steadfastness, resilience of people: Baqaei

📌 Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei, referring to Iran’s prudence and intelligence in confrontation with its enemies, says the country’s current authority is the result of steadfastness, intelligence, and the active presence of the people.

Speaking at the annual gathering of officials from the Council of Coordination on Islamic Propagation in Tehran on Thursday, Baqaei underscored that the enemy had come to realize that it could not break the will of the Iranian nation through pressure and threats.
​
He, in particular, referred to the public’s presence on city streets and squares in the face of the US-Israeli war of aggression, describing the people’s enthusiasm in evening gatherings as a valuable asset for Iran’s future.
​
According to him, such presence is not merely a domestic or social phenomenon, but rather conveys a clear message to the world regarding the unity, cohesion, authority, and popular backing enjoyed by the Islamic Republic of Iran.
​
Referring to the capacity and strength of Iran, he noted that Iran had experienced significant growth and development internationally – which the enemy is fully aware of, and any hostility or action against Iran would cost them dearly.
​
With a strong will, firm steps, and the aid of God Almighty, the Iranian nation will ensure the enemy comes to regret its actions and miscalculations, Baqaei asserted, as he briefed the audience on the assessments regarding the regional situation and international developments.
